_comment: Static Group BOQ Knowledge Model v1. Seeded from the two historical BOQs with quantities (Villa B QUO-SCC-1525-2026, Villa C QUO-SCC-1509-2026). Each canonical item generalises the same line across projects: how Static Group words it, measures it, from which drawings, and how far it can be automated today. 'engine' declares how the deterministic engine computes it; null = not yet automated. Nothing here is a quantity.

items.method: Commercial exclusion
Commercial exclusion

items.description: Temporary fencing around the premises - <L> Lm
items.method: Lump sum; the plot perimeter in metres is written into the description

items.description: Bulk excavation in isolated foundations, all tanks
items.method: Bulk dig over the building footprint and tanks from existing ground to underside of blinding, including working space
items.formula: Excavation footprint area x (NGL - formation level)
items.validation: Excavated volume must exceed sum of buried concrete + backfill
items.review: Ground levels and working-space allowance are not stated on the drawings

items.description: Removal of excavated materials from the site
items.method: Equal to bulk excavation quantity (both projects: identical value)

items.description: Backfilling and compacting with approved material in layers
items.method: Excavation minus the volume of buried construction (blinding, footings, neck columns, ground beams, tanks)

items.description: Anti-termite treatment to horizontal surfaces of ground
items.method: Lump sum
Excluded
Blinding outline area x blinding thickness (note on foundation details); historical quantities are larger than footing blinding alone, so blinding under ground beams is likely included
items.review: Confirm whether blinding under ground/tie beams is measured

items.method: Footing outline (S-FP) x footing depth from footing schedule (S-FD)

items.description: RC concrete work in neck columns
items.method: Column section at foundation (S-FP column outlines) x (ground beam soffit - top of footing)
items.review: Neck height depends on top of footing and ground-beam levels which vary per footing

items.description: RC concrete work in lift walls & additional concrete
items.method: Lift pit walls/base below ground + misc. additional concrete (estimator allowance)
